after_intervention: original frozen residual actor per step and nominal ACT inference at chunk exhaustion
feature_scope: frozen visual features, current observed state and active chunk, original residual
pair_training_budget: additional train-only V10/V11 contexts; account true control steps separately

selection_rules.enriched: maximum L2 norm of the frozen actor residual over visited pre-action ticks; earliest tick breaks ties
selection_rules.natural: one uniformly sampled visited pre-action tick per nominal source episode

raw_group_scope: nominal source rollout and real intervention trajectories for evidence only
time: logical control ticks measure refresh latency, wall time includes inference
